title: Refund policy
body: Duplicate charges and charges made after a confirmed cancellation are refundable in full. Refunds for any other reason are limited to the most recent invoice and must be requested within 14 days. Refunds over $100 require approval from a human billing specialist.

title: Changing or cancelling a plan
body: Customers can change plans at any time under Settings > Billing. Downgrades take effect at the next billing date. Cancellation stops future charges; the workspace stays readable for 30 days.

title: Failed payments and past-due accounts
body: When a payment fails we retry after 3, 5 and 7 days. The account is marked past due but keeps full access for 10 days. Customers can update their card under Settings > Billing > Payment method.

title: Resetting a password and two-factor authentication
body: Password resets are self-service from the sign-in page. Support can never view, set or send a password. Lost two-factor devices require identity verification by a human agent.

title: Data export
body: Workspace owners can export all data as CSV or JSON from Settings > Data. Exports over 5 GB are delivered by email link within 24 hours.

title: When to escalate to a human
body: Escalate legal threats, security incidents, suspected account takeover, requests to change account ownership, and anything the knowledge base does not cover.
